Name: Fruit Bats for BFAV
Author: Syanide23
Description:
[b]EDIT: This mod is obsolete.

For Stardew Valley 1.6 use this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22204]updated version[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/silvermoonchan/about-me?gameId=1303]silvermoonchan[/url].[/b]

There are six different colors of bats each of which leave a type of fruit from fruit trees. This mod is meant as a way to have fruit bats without having to sacrifice mushrooms in the cave, but it can be used alongside cave bats. Only the fruit trees available from Pierre/Joja are included, so no mangos or bananas.

Red bats drop apples
Orange bats drop oranges
Yellow bats drop apricots
Green bats drop cherries
Pink bats drop peaches
Purple bats drop pomegranate
